reviewDescription: I had high hopes for these earbuds based on the reviews, but those hopes were smashed about a week after receiving them. If you are looking for earbuds to listed to music or podcasts then these might just be the buds for you. More often than not we use our earbuds for phone calls as well and this is where these FAIL and FAIL badly. The first week I started using these I received or made a few quick calls where the conversations were a minute or less. The 2nd week when these were part of my regular routine, every call I made where I talked more than two minutes everyone asked what was wrong, are you driving? Or they asked was I underground, in an elevator, or in a tunnel? Then I finally started to hear issues on calls over ten mins you could here a popping sound and an echo. As I was reaching the end of my patience the reason I purchased these came full circle. A month prior I thought i lost my Anker Soundcore earbuds, which led me to try and find something new (which were these). I started to purchase some new soundcore earbuds but i knew if that lost earbud ever turned up I would be upset. While cleaning out my work bag what did i find down at the bottom.....the lost earbud. With the lost earbud found these were quickly placed on my bookshelf where they currently sit. I will most likely give these to my grandson so he can use them with his tablet. Stay away from these if you plan to use them for more than just listening.
